title: Quenched Hangover Brazilian Eggs Bake
description: A rich, gooey eggs bake to help alleviate hangover symptoms, featuring Brazilian flavors and a sugar-free-friendly recipe.

ingredients.name: Large eggs
ingredients.notes: Room temperature eggs for best results.

ingredients.name: Smoked bacon, diced
ingredients.notes: Use a sugar-free bacon for best results.

ingredients.name: Onion, diced
ingredients.notes: Use a yellow or white onion for best results.

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Use a garlic press for easy mincing.

ingredients.name: Ground mustard
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, whole-grain mustard for best results.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for best results.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a fresh, whole peppercorn for best results.

ingredients.name: Cheddar cheese, shredded
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, sugar-free cheddar for best results.

ingredients.name: Strong white flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-protein, unbleached flour for best results.

ingredients.name: Granulated sugar-free sweetener
ingredients.notes: Use a sugar-free sweetener like stevia or erythritol for best results.

ingredients.name: Cilantro, chopped
ingredients.notes: Use fresh cilantro for best results.

ingredients.name: Sour cream
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, full-fat sour cream for best results.

instructions: Cook the diced bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the diced onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, ground mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture, shredded cheddar cheese, and chopped cilantro to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the flour to the bowl and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top the egg mixture with the cooked bacon and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Bake the eggs bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the top is golden brown.
Remove the eggs bake from the oven and top with a dollop of sour cream.
Return the eggs bake to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the sour cream is lightly browned.
Remove the eggs bake from the oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
